name: failure_recovery_matrix
scope: Verify fail-closed behavior, rollback boundaries, and resumability when Discord or local persistence fails.

cases.fault: Discord rejects a resource creation midway through the build.
cases.expectation: Transaction boundary attempts cleanup of resources created by that operation; no successful partial configuration is committed as complete.

cases.fault: Managed resource ID points to a different resource type/name/category.
cases.expectation: Ownership preflight fails closed; unrelated resource is not adopted or deleted.

cases.fault: An expected stream category exists but is unmanaged or conflicts with the canonical identity.
cases.expectation: Add operation is rejected without silently adopting the conflicting category.

cases.fault: One journaled resource is already missing.
cases.expectation: Removal remains safe and resumable; missing resource is not rediscovered by name.

cases.fault: A journaled resource ID now resolves to a different name/type/category.
cases.expectation: Destructive resolution fails closed before deleting the mismatched resource.

cases.fault: Deletion fails after earlier journal entries have already been deleted.
cases.expectation: Journal/checkpoint state remains sufficient for a later retry to continue safely without name discovery.

cases.fault: Managed registry is invalid or inconsistent with live Discord state.
cases.expectation: Reset is blocked before destructive deletion.

cases.fault: An unmanaged same-name resource exists next to a managed resource.
cases.expectation: Only the persisted managed resource ID is eligible for deletion.

cases.fault: The managed timetable channel cannot be resolved.
cases.expectation: Publication is cancelled; no replacement channel is created by the command.

cases.fault: The managed exam channel cannot be resolved.
cases.expectation: Publication is cancelled; no replacement channel is created by the command.

cases.fault: Discord accepts the message but local persistence fails.
cases.expectation: The failure is surfaced as a persistence problem and later reconciliation can detect the live message/channel state without inventing a new channel.

cases.fault: Discord accepts the exam message but local persistence fails.
cases.expectation: The failure is surfaced; rerunning does not depend on a guessed channel name for destructive behavior.
Original managed school roles are restored where Discord permits, and no successful enrollment state is recorded.

cases.fault: Persistence fails after Discord role mutation.
cases.expectation: The command reports the failure; role/persistence reconciliation is covered by recovery/regression tests rather than claiming atomicity across systems.
History is not marked as left and original managed roles are restored where possible.

cases.fault: Target year does not exist or cannot be activated.
cases.expectation: No partial academic-year state is committed.

cases.fault: SQLite state is authoritative but JSON cache is stale/corrupt.
cases.expectation: Startup recovery rebuilds or refreshes the JSON cache from logical source-of-truth state without inventing Discord resources.

cases.fault: The same failed operation is retried after partial external success.
cases.expectation: Retry is idempotent or safely reconciles from persisted IDs/journal state; it does not duplicate or delete unrelated resources.
